comments: Registered as one bank on the lowest line of the door frame and footing; the pivot x is the centre of the footing stones. Painted 75 of 80 px wide. The scroll rail overlaps the ground-floor window beside the door in every state; that is how it was drawn.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the palette snap had sent brown-grey flecks (source about 816347) to an olive ink (69793e) and the dark brown outline (source about 231d1b) to a dark green one (182414); the grade maps those two admitted shared inks to the browns 684629 and 25140b; no pixel is moved, added or removed.
geometry: The footprint, the door tile and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: day-0, night-0, lit-0. The crops are tight and separated by the empty columns 507-519 and 1016-1027, so none is merged.

size_basis: native canvas 80x76, anchor bottom-centre (40,76); the bottom edge is the footprint's south edge; stage 384x224; a knight is 16x24 in this town; buildings may stand taller than their footprint.
